trials.reasoning: The vendor's own page offers only up to 30 days risk-free, directly conflicting with the claimed 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: Buy Pinflux2, and use it for up to 30 days risk-free. If you don't like what it does
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own guarantee limits refunds to 30 days, contradicting the claimed 60-day money-back guarantee.

trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show the vendor's regular website and subscription prices, which do not prove what deal buyers were charged for the $99 Single plan, and no exhibit confirms the deal checkout price.

exhibits.quote: if you view their website, it cost $37 but there is actually an upsell to get Pinflux Pro
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the vendor website price is $37 plus a $67 upsell, undermining the claimed $99 Single plan price.

exhibits.quote: Pinflux Elite Monthly $27 Monthly Free Upgrades 24 / 6 Chat Support Pinflux Elite Yearly
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own page lists Monthly $27 and Yearly pricing instead of the claimed $99 Single plan.

trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the vendor website actually sells it for $37 plus an upsell, conflicting with the claim that the Single plan's regular price was $328.

exhibits.quote: if you view their website, it cost $37 but there is actually an upsell to get Pinflux Pro
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports actual vendor price of $37 plus upsell, undermining the claimed $328 regular price.

exhibits.quote: I bought 3 tiers with a total value of 297.00.

trials.claim: Pinflux is the best Pinterest marketing and automation tool
trials.claimQuote: Pinflux - Best Pinterest Marketing and Automation Tool
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report poor quality, poor service, and buggy alpha software they could not use, undercutting the vendor's own 'most powerful' marketing claim to be the best tool.

exhibits.quote: Poor Quality Product along with Poor Service. I had high hopes for this solution because the use case is a big need on the Pinterest platform, but I was quickly disappointed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports poor quality product and service and disappointment, contradicting best tool claim.

exhibits.quote: Buggy alpha version software with no support. I didn't make a single pin with this software.
exhibits.argument: Buyer calls it buggy alpha with no support and zero pins made, undermining best tool claim.

exhibits.quote: The most powerful Pinterest marketing app ever. Pinflux has the features that competitors
exhibits.argument: Vendor calls Pinflux the most powerful Pinterest marketing app, supporting the best-tool claim.

trials.claim: Increase buyer traffic from Pinterest using Pinflux
trials.claimQuote: Increase your buyer traffic from Pinterest on full automation within a few days using Pinflux.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report making not a single pin and that core follow/unfollow functions simply do not work, outweighing one vague positive review and a general statistic about Pinterest buyers.

exhibits.quote: Buggy alpha version software with no support. I didn't make a single pin with this software.
exhibits.argument: Buyer made not a single pin, contradicting claim of increased buyer traffic.

exhibits.quote: I purchased this software specifically to follow and unfollow other Pinterest accounts. It simply does not work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports core follow/unfollow functions simply do not work, undermining traffic growth claim.

exhibits.quote: Over 80% Of Pinterest Traffic Is Buyers Looking At Products All Day
exhibits.argument: Vendor states Pinterest traffic consists of buyers looking at products, supporting buyer-traffic claim.

exhibits.quote: Pinflux is an easy to use interface. If you want to increase your traffic with pinterest, you are in the right place!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms Pinflux is the right place to increase traffic with Pinterest.

trials.claimQuote: Increase your buyer traffic from Pinterest on full automation within a few days using Pinflux.

exhibits.quote: Monitoring and calibrating a few minutes every day is all you need.
exhibits.argument: Vendor admits daily manual monitoring is needed, contradicting full automation claim.

exhibits.quote: It only works when you start the program. (It seemed to not function if I left the program running.)
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports automation does not run on its own and requires restart, undermining full automation claim.

exhibits.quote: Designed for hands-free automation. Set it up and forget, or get as much control as you want.

exhibits.quote: This is a great tool for Pinterest users because it automates a lot of the work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool automates a lot of the Pinterest work.
